name: ChilliPopup
author: Chillipopup

sections.description:
ChilliPopup is a popup builder for WordPress and WooCommerce that goes beyond the popup: build popups, exit-intent lead-capture forms, multi-step surveys (NPS, CSAT, CES), multiple-choice quizzes and four prize games — a spin-to-win wheel, a scratch card, a slot machine and a claw machine — in one visual editor, then let this plugin put them live on your site.

Describe the campaign in a sentence (“flash-sale popup with a countdown and 15% off”) and the built-in AI drafts it; refine every block in the drag-and-drop editor, choose from 77 templates, set the display rules, publish. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your ChilliPopup workspace so everything you publish goes live automatically — nothing to paste into your theme.

What you can launch

  • Popups — offers, announcements, coupon and countdown popups, slide-ins and banners.
  • Lead-capture forms — validated email, name, phone and consent fields, shown on exit intent, scroll, time delay, page count, click or inactivity.
  • Surveys and quizzes — multi-step on-site surveys with NPS/CSAT/CES scoring, product-finder quizzes with per-question results.
  • Prize games — spin the wheel, scratch card, slot machine, claw machine. Odds are decided on ChilliPopup’s server, so nobody can cheat, and the discount code is only revealed on a win.
  • Targeting — six triggers plus device, page-URL, browser, date-and-time and new-vs-returning rules, with frequency caps. Perfect for WooCommerce product, cart and checkout pages.
  • A/B testing and analytics — turn any campaign into an A/B test in one click; see views, clicks and conversions per campaign in the ChilliPopup dashboard.

Plugin features

  • One-field setup: paste your Workspace ID and you’re done.
  • Paste-friendly: drop in your full installation snippet or pixel URL and the plugin extracts the ID.
  • On/off switch so you can pause ChilliPopup without deactivating the plugin.
  • No bundled tracking code — it loads the always-up-to-date hosted player, so you never have to update a script by hand.
  • Lightweight: a single async <script> tag, nothing else added to your pages. No iframe, no impact on your theme’s rendering.

ChilliPopup has a free plan — $0/month, forever, with no credit card and no time limit: 1,000 visitors a month, one site, one team member and 10 AI drafts a day, including every campaign type and all four prize games. Paid plans (Pro $29/month, Business $79/month, each with a 14-day free trial) raise the monthly visitor limit and add more sites and team members. A small “Powered by ChilliPopup” badge is shown under your campaigns on every plan, free and paid alike.

Under the hood it simply adds the official ChilliPopup pixel to every front-end page:

<script id="chillipopup-pixel" src="https://player.chillipopup.com/javascript/pixel.js?id=YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID" data-api="https://api.chillipopup.com" async="true"></script>

That is the exact same installation tag as ChilliPopup’s HTML/JavaScript method — the plugin just manages it for you, so you never touch your theme.

Features

  • One-field setup: paste your Workspace ID and you’re done.
  • Paste-friendly: drop in your full installation snippet or pixel URL and the plugin extracts the ID.
  • On/off switch so you can pause ChilliPopup without deactivating the plugin.
  • No bundled tracking code — it loads the always-up-to-date hosted player, so you never have to update a script by hand.
  • Lightweight: a single async <script> tag, nothing else added to your pages.

External services

This plugin connects your site to the ChilliPopup service to load and run your popups and inline forms. ChilliPopup is a product of Kompassify SARL. The plugin adds a single hosted <script> tag to your front-end pages; that script, and the player code it loads, then contact the following ChilliPopup hosts. Nothing is contacted until a visitor loads a front-end page while the plugin is enabled and a Workspace ID is set.

  • player.chillipopup.com — the visitor’s browser downloads the ChilliPopup player script from https://player.chillipopup.com/javascript/pixel.js (using the Workspace ID you configure). This is the only script the plugin itself adds to your site.
  • api.chillipopup.com — the player calls the ChilliPopup API (passed to it as the data-api attribute) to fetch your published popup/form content (for example /popups/live and /forms/live).

  • analytics-api.chillipopup.com — the player reports popup/form performance to the ChilliPopup analytics service: opens, clicks, closes and submissions (including the values a visitor enters into a form), together with your workspace ID and a per-visit session identifier. This is sent only in response to a visitor interacting with a popup or form.

  • Service provider: ChilliPopup (Kompassify SARL) — https://chillipopup.com

  • Terms of Service: https://chillipopup.com/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://chillipopup.com/privacy.html

If you do not want to send any data to ChilliPopup, leave the Workspace ID empty or turn the plugin off on the settings screen.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ChilliPopup in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Paste your Workspace ID (find it in your ChilliPopup dashboard → Install) and save.

That’s it — your published popups and forms now appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Workspace ID?

In your ChilliPopup dashboard, open the Install page. Your installation snippet contains id=... — that value is your Workspace ID. You can also paste the whole snippet into the plugin’s Workspace ID field and it will pull the ID out automatically.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The plugin adds a single asynchronous <script> tag. The player itself is hosted by ChilliPopup and loaded in the background, so it does not block your page from rendering.

Do I need a ChilliPopup account?

Yes. The plugin connects an existing ChilliPopup workspace to your site. Creating one is free — sign up at https://dashboard.chillipopup.com/#/register, no credit card required.

Is ChilliPopup free?

Yes — ChilliPopup has a permanent free plan: $0/month, no credit card, no time limit. It covers 1,000 visitors a month, one site, one team member and 10 AI drafts a day, and it includes every campaign type — popups, forms, surveys, quizzes and all four prize games — with the full editor, targeting, A/B testing and analytics.

Paid plans (Pro $29/month, Business $79/month, each with a 14-day free trial) raise the monthly visitor limit and add more sites and team members. A small “Powered by ChilliPopup” badge is shown under your campaigns on every plan, free and paid alike.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The pixel loads on every front-end page, and ChilliPopup’s page-URL targeting lets you show a campaign only on product, category, cart or checkout URLs (for example an exit-intent coupon on /cart/).

Which games are included?

Spin-to-win wheel, scratch card, slot machine and claw machine. The winner is decided server-side, prize codes are revealed only on a win, and every game reports plays, wins and emails captured.

Can visitors take a survey or quiz on my site?

Yes. Surveys (NPS, CSAT, CES, star and thumbs scoring) and multiple-choice quizzes open as multi-step overlays, built and published from the same ChilliPopup dashboard.

Where do I see the leads and answers?

In your ChilliPopup dashboard, per campaign. ChilliPopup does not send emails or push leads to a newsletter tool; you read and manage them in the dashboard.

How do I temporarily disable ChilliPopup?

Open the ChilliPopup settings screen and untick “Load ChilliPopup on this site”, then save. The pixel will stop loading without deleting your settings.
